# Bid the opening, not the window.

> Price a window replacement job from United Inches, story, and tear-out — not a flat price per window. See walk-away price, average per opening, and the margin a $550-a-window special actually leaves.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
